item.title: Young scientists shine at Regional Science Olympiad
item.description: Budding young scientists from throughout the region participated in the 41st Annual Stanislaus County Regional Science Olympiad on March 14 at Modesto Junior College.

item.title: Bonta, Gray agree that tariffs are hurting Central Valley
item.description: MODESTO — California Attorney General Rob Bonta and Rep. Adam Gray (D-Merced) were guests this week of the Modesto Chamber of Commerce, and their message was clear: President Donald Trump’s tariff are not working.

item.title: Delhi High School teacher arrested in child pornography investigation
item.description: MERCED COUNTY — A Delhi High School teacher was arrested Wednesday after a joint investigation by the Merced County Sheriff’s Office and the Fresno Internet Crimes Against Children Task Force into the possession and distribution of child pornography.

item.title: If you steal in Stanislaus County, you will be arrested
item.description: We’ve all been there. You stop by the store to buy shampoo, some razors, maybe a pair of fingernail clippers … it’s a stop you’d expect to take just a couple of minutes.

item.title: OCCUPATIONAL OLYMPIANS
item.description: Local students really shined at the 40th Annual Stanislaus County Occupational Olympics and Career Exposition was held Thursday at the Stanislaus County Fairgrounds, with Turlock High taking the Large School Overall Award and Hughson High taking the Small School Overall Award.

item.title: LEGISLATIVE ROUNDUP: Alanis joins effort to bring health products to female farmworkers
item.description: Assemblyman Juan Alanis (R-Modesto) today joined Assemblyman Jeff Gonzalez (R-Indio), fellow legislators, and farmworkers at the state Capitol to highlight Assembly Bill 2082, the Rural Farmworker Women’s Health Act of 2026.

item.title: Council renews fire admin contract with Modesto in split vote
item.description: The cities of Turlock and Modesto will remain linked for fire services after the Turlock City Council voted 3-2 Tuesday night in favor of renewing the agreement that is set to expire on June 30.

item.title: On the hunt
item.description: Normally green fields in the area will soon be speckled with pink, blue, yellow, purple, orange and red as there are a number of Easter egg hunts scheduled for the upcoming weekend.

item.title: Crosstown Cup, Turlock and Pitman match highlight busy week at TGCC
item.description: Local high school golfers kept the grounds crew at Turlock Golf and Country Club busy over the past week with a slew of events including critical Central California Athletic League matches and one of the most popular annual tournaments in the region.

item.title: Bulldogs sweep Gregori; Pride win series over Enochs
item.description: The Turlock and Pitman high school baseball programs are off to winning starts in the Central California, as the Bulldogs capped off a sweep of Gregori and the Pride split the final two games of their series with Enochs on Friday.

item.title: TURLOCK HIGH FFA PLANT SALE
item.description: Day 1 of the annual Turlock High School FFA Plant Sale is in the books, with Day 2 set to take place today from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. at THS.

item.title: Governor calls out Turlock on housing law issues
item.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom has the city of Turlock, and other jurisdictions, in his political crosshairs after issuing “final warnings” for “breaking state housing law.”

item.title: Turlock ties a yellow ribbon in honor of Vietnam veterans
item.description: American Legion Post 88 Commander Carl Lassiter was one of the Vietnam War veterans who attended Friday’s ceremony at Turlock’s Public Safety Facility.

item.title: Medeiros celebrates 20 years of educating star students
item.description: Twenty years ago, Megan Speckman was one of the first students at the newly opened Medeiros Elementary School in north Turlock.

item.title: ‘This could be me’
item.description: Jeffrey Kern is tall, broad-shouldered and movie-star handsome, with the intense looks of a young Brando. And that’s a good thing, since the Pitman High senior wants to be a professional actor someday.
